snippet.title: Phobophobia 1.0 – The Experiment | Official Psychological Horror Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Phobophobia 1.0 – The Experiment is a story-driven psychological horror where you must survive 10 phobia-inspired rooms filled with puzzles, dread, and disturbing truths. Every decision matters, and every fear brings you closer to the truth.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3981410/Phobophobia_10__The_Experiment/

Stay tuned for more updates and join our growing community as we dive deeper into fear.
